_comment: Public chatbot settings (spec claude/NRG_spec_chatbot_public_2026-10-08.md). worker_url is filled in once the Cloudflare Worker is deployed; empty means the public page runs search-only. claude_url is the shared link to the Claude version (the artifact), offered when a visitor's daily questions are used; empty hides the button. daily_questions is for display; the Worker's RATE_PER_DAY is what counts.
